title: Calibration models
description: 2 calibration models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.
html:
2 calibration models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: the camera intrinsics [3, 3] and, where the model estimates them, the gravity direction in the camera frame, roll, pitch and vertical field of view.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under torch.compile and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable (export; memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA A10, NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000; across devices.
